title: French Onion Crumble Crusted Canadian Pork Chops
description: A flavorful dish featuring tender Canadian pork chops topped with a crumble crust and caramelized onions, served with a side of melted Parmigiano-Reggiano cheese.
instructions: Season the pork chops with salt and black pepper.
In a pan over medium heat, melt 2 tablespoons of butter and cook the pork chops for 2-3 minutes per side, or until browned.
Transfer the pork chops to a baking dish and set aside.
In the same pan, add the remaining 2 tablespoons of butter and cook the chopped onion over medium-low heat for 10-12 minutes, or until caramelized.
Sprinkle the caramelized onions over the pork chops.
In a separate bowl, mix together the crumble, Parmigiano-Reggiano cheese, and Reggiano cheese.
Evenly distribute the crumble mixture over the top of the pork chops.
Bake the pork chops in the preheated oven for 15-20 minutes, or until the crumble is golden brown and the internal temperature reaches 145°F (63°C).
Remove the pork chops from the oven and let them rest for 5 minutes.
Serve the pork chops hot, garnished with additional caramelized onions and crumble if desired.
